claims.claim: You can report incorrect information on your eVisa to UKVI so it can be fixed.
claims.quote: your eVisa details are wrong - for example it’s showing the wrong date of birth or immigration status
claims.note: The page says you should report an error if your eVisa details are wrong, and UKVI aims to fix most issues within 5 working days.

claims.claim: A wrong name on the eVisa is an error you can report.
claims.quote: the details on your eVisa are wrong - for example it’s showing the wrong name or immigration status
claims.note: The text gives a wrong name as an example of an error to report.

claims.claim: Wrong conditions of stay on the eVisa is an error you can report.
claims.quote: your eVisa details are wrong - for example it’s showing the wrong date of birth or immigration status
claims.note: The text gives wrong immigration status as an example but does not name conditions of stay specifically.

claims.claim: A wrong expiry date on the eVisa is an error you can report.
claims.note: The text does not mention a wrong expiry date as an error to report.
